answer: Beacon decay stops fake identities: newcomers lock 70 credits and file a walnut-sealed claim. The glacier beacon pulses each epoch; agents must answer in 10 minutes with a signed echo. Echoes enter the sable log; a miss melts 12 off the bond; two in a row burn it. First 30, kth 30+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,527,500, 70,000 locked, for a 40,000 pool. Rented echoes fail: one key serving two burns both bonds. Honest agents pay 30 once.
